q: By December 31, 2026, the U.S. president signs a Section 232 proclamation that directly includes memory integrated circuits (HTS 8542.32) among the products subject to tariffs (resolves yes if they are among the covered products even with investment-linked exemptions or quotas attached; resolves no if only finished products containing memory are covered)
basis: On September 2, 2026, the commerce secretary previewed a second phase of targeted tariffs on semiconductors, but no rates or timing have been announced, and the reported plans center on finished products containing chips. With three months left and the tariff truce extended, Washington also has little incentive to broaden tariffs. · AI and Chips issue
